rationale: The assistant correctly framed V8 pulsing as airflow restriction from the outset, gave safe instructions (battery out, cold water only, full 24h dry, no running without filter) and reached the right no-part resolution. However it drifted into an unsupported battery-contacts step ('the next sensible thing to try is the battery connection') and repeatedly dangled an 'internal motor/electronics fault' fallback, while the decisive wand check was only done because the customer asked 'did u want me to look down the wand too?'. It also failed to tell the customer not to dry the filter on a radiator, and one turn was lost to 'AI service unavailable'. Overall a useful, safe conversation that resolved the fault with some inefficiency.
